label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Finale in Doubt
items.text: LIV Golf's 2026 Team Championship in Michigan is "95% likely" to be canceled, which threatens the league’s signature team format and could push Bryson DeChambeau, whose contract ends this season, to leave.

items.headline: DeChambeau Penalty Accepted
items.text: Joaquin Niemann stated that Bryson DeChambeau's two-shot penalty at The Open was correctly enforced, emphasizing the importance of rules enforcement in golf's honor-based culture despite the penalty's frustration.

items.headline: Aaron Wise Opens Up on Mental Health
items.text: Aaron Wise revealed a rapid mental health decline after the 2022 Tour Championship led to his withdrawal before the 2023 Masters and a year-and-a-half break, now returning to competition at the 3M Open with support from a sports neuroscientist.
